summary_en: 500,000 shares (12.52% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) ¥987.5M upper limit. ToSTNeT-3 off-hours execution on 2026-08-03 at ¥1,975/share (final special quote of 2026-07-31 close). Results published after 08:45 JST market close.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and share purchases via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Maruhachi Securities' board of directors resolved on 2026-07-31 to execute a share buyback under the company's articles of association and the Companies Act Article 165(2). The company will acquire up to 500,000 common shares for a maximum outlay of ¥987.5M via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 2026-08-03 at 08:45 JST, using the final special quote closing price of ¥1,975/share from 2026-07-31. The acquired shares represent 12.52% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury baseline of 3,991,080 shares). Results will be published immediately after the 08:45 transaction concludes. The company cited capital-cost and share-price-conscious management as the buyback rationale. Partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions and order matching.
